title: Mixed Event — Picture Perfect! — Episode1 The Arts Festival

meta.Event Outline: When Kamiyama High School's very first Arts Festival is announced, Class 2-A decides to produce a film! It falls to Nene to sit in the director's chair, but will her leadership cut it?

rows.Line: Kamiyama High School - Class 2-A

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Hey, An, check this out!
It's apparently one of the parfaits you can get at carino/carina...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, that's gigantic!
I mean, just look at all the strawberries... Is it even possible to finish it?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Three of us should be able to if we work together! We should go sometime since it's been going totally viral on TrickTrick!

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Hey, Akito!
You free after school today?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: No, but why...?

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: I found this cool shop that I was thinking about checking out! I know you're busy with practice, but we need to hang out more!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (This class is never quiet...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I was hoping to do some reading before our long homeroom started, but I won't be able to focus with all this noise...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
(I guess I'll just listen to some music instead while I wait for the teacher to get here.)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Okay, everyone, take your seats.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, see you guys later!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: See you! We'll talk again later.

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line: So, what are we gonna do during the long homeroom today?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Oh, about that.
I have something very important to discuss with you all today.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Something important...?)

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: Starting this year, we will be holding an event called the “Kamiyama High School Arts Festival”.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: An arts festival?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: As you all know, this school prides itself on fostering creativity and freedom of expression. Because of that, we're always receiving and coming up with ideas for new school events.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: For this festival, with creativity and cooperation in mind, the students in each class will work together to produce and present an artistic piece.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: These presentations will be ranked the day of, and we also plan on inviting a famed figure to serve as a special judge...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Wait, a famed figure...? You're talking about a celebrity, right?! Who are you guys inviting?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Also, you said, “An artistic piece.”
Can you tell us a little more about that...?

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line:
Of course.
There aren't any strict rules to speak of...

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: As long as you all work together with a spirit of cooperation in mind, you'll basically be free to do whatever you like.

rows.Speaker: Teacher
rows.Line: To name a few examples, you could do a play, put on a small concert, make a movie or perform a dance... Producing a sculpture together could also be fun.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're free to choose whatever...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A play or a concert... So I might be able to sing? That'd definitely get me interested...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But we all have to work together...
Not exactly my strong suit.)

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: This sounds super fun!!!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! It's like we get to have another school festival!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, I should've known they'd react this way...)

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
What should we do?
I really wanna make a film together!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Me too!
Making one as a class could be a way to make the most of our youth!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Youth, huh...? I don't know about that, but a film would definitely be memorable since it'll pretty much last forever.

rows.Speaker: Male Students
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'm not hearing any other ideas, so let's make a film together!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (A film...?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Is it possible for a bunch of amateurs to actually make one...? It sounds like a lot of work...)

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Hold on a second...
Making one isn't as easy as you guys are making it sound.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I don't know much about filmmaking, but I'm guessing it's gonna take a lot of time and effort. We should plan things out a little better before we decide.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Yeah, exactly...!)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Hmm... He has a point.
It might be good for us to appoint a leader, like a director. Someone with experience or who knows a lot about this stuff...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Someone who knows a lot...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Oh!
I know the perfect person!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The perfect person? Who...?)

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Kusanagi!
Could you be our director?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
You're in the film club, right?
And you perform in shows!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: You seem like the right person for the job since you have a ton of knowledge and experience when it comes to films and acting!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Th-Thanks, but...
For the film club, we just watch the movies we have in our room...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Plus, acting for a stage performance and acting in a film are two different things. I really don't know if I could be a director...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: Really? But...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Alright, hold your horses!
You're making her panic. We can't just ask her to do this all of a sudden.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right...
Sorry, Kusanagi. I didn't mean to sound so pushy.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
N-No, uh...
That's okay...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: But I do think that you're the best choice out of everyone in this class to become the director...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: I saw you perform in a show at PXL a little while ago, and I was blown away by how good it was!

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: You guys come up with those shows all on your own, right? I figured if you know how to make something that amazing, then you'd be able to do the same for our film.

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line: So, you don't have to if you don't want to... But will you at least think about it?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(Right.
Some of them have seen our shows.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (To be fair, I did help come up with a few of those stories, so I might be a little more experienced than everyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(But I've never made a film before.
Not only that...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (The director has to get everyone to move as a unit while staying on schedule for production, right?)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-I'm supposed to get all these chatterboxes to work as a team...?)

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
How do you feel, Kusanagi...?
Again, you don't have to if you don't want to.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-Yeah, I know...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Opportunities to lead big teams like this don't come around often, so maybe I should accept.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Also, I can't be afraid of working with new people...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (We're gonna be working with other troupes moving forward... And my goal's to become a world-class musical actress.)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I-I'll do it.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
It'll be a good experience for me...
So if you're all okay with it, I think I'll take the job...

rows.Speaker: Female Students
rows.Line:
Really?!
Thanks so much, Kusanagi!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Y-You're welcome...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (W-Well, I just agreed...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(There's no turning back now...
And if we're making a film, I wanna make it a good one...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
(I-I've gotta do my best.
For the sake of the festival...!)
